mechanism: Benztropine's anticholinergic properties combined with betamethasone's immunosuppression and fluid retention effects may increase risks of urinary retention, constipation, and CNS effects; betamethasone may mask anticholinergic side effects.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic adverse effects (urinary retention, constipation, confusion) and assess necessity of concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and bowel function management.
